items.html:
One of the hardest workers and most intense players in the Dutch Team, with
a very good sense of humour. Has been playing in Australia and South Africa
over the last two winters (2001-02-03) and he should be able to take this
experience with him and become Holland's number one left-arm spinner during
the World Cup.
Exciting middle order batsman with a strong accurate arm when fielding.
